text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan Pendidikan

(Penggal Institusi Pendidikan Tahun 2020) 2020.

Pemakaian

2. Peraturan-Peraturan ini terpakai bagi kehadiran di institusi pendidikan bagi

tahun 2020.

Tempoh penggal institusi pendidikan

3. Tempoh penggal institusi pendidikan bagi tahun 2020 adalah sebagaimana

yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Kumpulan A Penggal Pertama

Semua institusi pendidikan di Johor, Kedah, 1 Januari 2020 hingga 12 Mac 2020

Kelantan dan Terengganu 22 Mac 2020 hingga 21 Mei 2020

 Penggal Kedua

 7 Jun 2020 hingga 19 Ogos 2020

 25 Ogos 2020 hingga 17 Disember 2020

Kumpulan B Penggal Pertama

Semua institusi pendidikan di Melaka,

Negeri Sembilan, Pahang, Perak,

Perlis, Pulau Pinang, Sabah, Sarawak,

Selangor, Wilayah Persekutuan Kuala

Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan Labuan

dan Wilayah Persekutuan Putrajaya

 2 Januari 2020 hingga 13 Mac 2020

 23 Mac 2020 hingga 22 Mei 2020

 Penggal Kedua

 8 Jun 2020 hingga 19 Ogos 2020

 25 Ogos 2020 hingga 18 Disember 2020

Pembatalan

4. Peraturan-Peraturan Pendidikan (Penggal Institusi Pendidikan Tahun 2020) 2019

[P.U. (A) 348/2019] dibatalkan.

Dibuat 19 Jun 2020

[KPMSP.100-1/7/1; PN(PU2)569/XIV]

DR. RADZI BIN JIDIN

Menteri Kanan Pendidikan

EDUCATION ACT 1996

EDUCATION (TERMS OF EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS YEAR 2020)

REGULATIONS 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 130(2)(b) of the

Education Act 1996 [Act 550], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation

Application

2. These Regulations shall apply to attendance at educational institutions for the

year 2020.

Duration of terms of educational institutions

3. The duration of terms of educational institutions for the year 2020 shall be as

specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

 Group A First Term

All educational institutions in Johore,

Kedah, Kelantan and Terengganu

1 January 2020 to 12 March 2020

22 March 2020 to 21 May 2020

 Second Term

7 June 2020 to 19 August 2020

25 August 2020 to 17 December 2020

1. These regulations may be cited as the Education (Terms of Educational

Institutions Year 2020) Regulations 2020.

 Group B First Term

All educational institutions in

Malacca, Negeri Sembilan, Pahang,

Perak, Perlis, Penang, Sabah,

Sarawak, Selangor, Federal Territory

of Kuala Lumpur, Federal Territory

of Labuan and Federal Territory of

Putrajaya

2 January 2020 to 13 March 2020

23 March 2020 to 22 May 2020

 Second Term

8 June 2020 to 19 August 2020

25 August 2020 to 18 December 2020

Revocation

4. The Education (Terms of Educational Institutions Year 2020) Regulations 2019

[P.U. (A) 348/2019] are revoked.

Made 19 June 2020

[KPMSP.100-1/7/1; PN(PU2)569/XIV]

DR. RADZI BIN JIDIN

Senior Minister of Education
